title: Atlanta Rapper DJ Unk, Behind Hits 'Walk It Out' and '2 Step,' Dies at 43
htmlContent:
DJ Unk, born Anthony Platt, a pioneering Atlanta rapper and producer who died at 43, has been mourned by the hip-hop world. DJ Unk, known for his eloquent hits 'Walk It Out' and '2 Step,' pioneered the snap music era, a subgenre of crunk that shaped the mid-2000s. His contributions to the music industry are still unforgettable, and his legacy inspires fans and artists worldwide.

The Rise of a Snap Music Legend

DJ Unk was born during a transformative period in hip-hop when Southern sounds were the dominant sound on the airwaves. Born and raised in Atlanta, Anthony Platt began his career at 17, honing his craft as a DJ under the mentorship of DJ Jelly and DJ Montay as part of the Southern Style DJs collective. This pivotal partnership solidified Unk's reputation as a skilled turntablist and laid the groundwork for his entry into the recording industry. In 2000, DJ Unk signed with Big Oomp Records, a label known for its involvement in the growth of Atlanta's hip-hop scene. His debut album, “Beat’n Down Yo Block!” released in 2006 through Koch Records, catapulted him to stardom. The album featured high-energy beats and catchy hooks, with standout tracks like 'Walk It Out' and '2 Step' dominating the charts. These tracks strengthened Unk's position as a driving force in the snap music movement, wresonating in clubs anddance floors.

“Walk It Out” and Its Cultural Impact

DJ Unk became known for his signature song, 'Walk It Out,' which peaked at No. 2 on the Billboard Hot Rap Songs chart and crossed into the mainstream. DJ Montay's infectious beat and simple but irresistible dance instructions made the song an instant classic. The remix featured verses from hip-hop legends André 3000 and Jim Jones and enhanced the song's appeal. It demonstrated Unk's ability to unite different talents on a single track. Walk It Out transcended music and became a cultural phenomenon. The danceable rhythm made it a popular choice for parties, sporting events, and fitness classes. The accompanying dance craze increased in popularity, influencing countless choreographed routines and social media trends.

“2 Step”: A Testament to DJ Unk’s Versatility

After the success of Walk It Out, Unk continued his streak by releasing 2 Step, another chart-topping hit that reached No. 4 on the Billboard Hot Rap Songs chart. The track showcased Unk's talent for creating music that resonated with diverse audiences. Unk's reputation as a dance music innovator was further enhanced by the accompanying dance, which encouraged listeners to 'two-step' to the beat. Unk's ability to collaborate with some of the biggest names in the industry was highlighted by a star-studded remix that featured artists like T-Pain, Jim Jones, and E-40.

A Career Marked by Resilience

DJ Unk was confronted with significant challenges despite his meteoric rise. At the age of 26, he had a heart attack in August 2009, which he blamed on the pressures of non-stop touring, unhealthy eating habits, and stress. In a 2010 interview with XXL Magazine, Unk openly discussed the impact of his lifestyle on his health, stressing the importance of self-care. "It’s a blessing to be here. I’ve been on the road since 2006 and at this age—I’m 28 right now—a lot of people don’t get to see 28. A lot of people don’t get to see 15, 10, some babies. It’s a blessing for me to celebrate [another] a birthday. I had some medical issues going on from not eating the right food and that just come from when I stopped taking care of myself. I got to get healthy not just for my sake, but also for my kids and for my wife." Though his output slowed down in the years following his health scare, Unk remained a fixture in the music scene. He produced singles and mixtapes throughout his career, culminating in the 2017 album 'Fresh Off Dem Papers'.
Although his later projects did not achieve the same commercial success as his earlier work, they demonstrated his commitment to his craft and his enduring love for music.
Multiple sources, including family members and Big Oomp Records, confirmed the news of DJ Unk's passing. In a sincere social media post, his wife, Sherkita Long-Platt, articulated her sadness, writing: “I just lost my husband, and my kids just lost their father. Our life will never be the same. I LOVE YOU ANTHONY FOREVER.”

Legacy and Lasting Impact

DJ Unk's influence is well-known beyond his chart-topping hits. As a pioneer of hip-hop snap music, he helped shape a genre that continues to influence contemporary hip-hop. The joy he brought to countless fans and the new generation of artists who experimented with danceable beats and relatable lyrics were inspired by his music. Unk had a memorable performance at the 2023 BET Awards, where he performed with Soulja Boy and F.L.Y. Their iconic hits were modeled together to remind us of his enduring legacy.

Final Thoughts

DJ Unk's passing is a significant loss for the music industry and his fans worldwide. His contribution to hip-hop, particularly the snap music movement, has left a lasting impression on the genre. Anthony Platt's life's dedication to creativity, resilience, and the power of music to bring people together is celebrated as we remember him.
